3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:d9c634ce-67a8.title: Staff Software Engineer, Frontend
3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:d9c634ce-67a8.description: About Us At 3Y Health, we are building AI-driven software to empower healthcare providers and solve the overwhelming administrative complexity that consumes 40% of the industry’s revenue. Our end-to-end platform unlocks opportunities for clinician entrepreneurs, enabling medical professionals to launch, run, and grow private practices. By supporting these independent practices with the latest AI and automation, we’re helping providers reclaim their time, build thriving businesses, and deliver better outcomes for their communities. 3Y Health is backed by over $200M from top-tier investors including Founders Fund, General Catalyst, Softbank, and 8VC. About the Role We are seeking a Frontend Engineer to help us craft intuitive, high-performance user interfaces that our providers love. The ideal candidate is a product-minded engineer with deep expertise in modern frontend development (React, TypeScript) and a strong sense of design and user interaction quality. You care about clean, modular code, and can collaborate closely with design and product to bring elegant experiences to life. Bonus points if you have light full-stack capabilities and can own backend tweaks to unblock your team. Ideal candidates may have experience as a founding engineer or founder and bring a bias toward ownership, speed, and continuous iteration. This role requires a dynamic individual who can drive frontend architecture decisions and work cross-functionally across engineering, design, and product teams. As a Frontend Engineer, you will be responsible for delivering scalable, modular UI components, collaborating on product development, and shaping the user experience of our AI-first platform. RESPONSIBILITIES - Build and maintain reusable, performant, and accessible frontend components using React and TypeScript - Work closely with designers to bring beautiful, user-centered experiences to life - Own UX polish and interaction quality; continuously seek ways to improve usability - Collaborate with backend engineers to define API interfaces and occasionally implement backend logic as needed - Influence frontend architectural decisions and promote best practices in code modularity and maintainability - Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and team rituals - Bring a founder’s mindset—proactive, product-focused, and eager to take ownership Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree required - 5+ years of experience in frontend engineering roles - Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, modern JavaScript, and frontend architecture - Track record of delivering high-quality UI/UX in close collaboration with design/product - Ability to write clean, modular, scalable code with an eye for reusability - Bonus: experience with backend technologies (Node.js, Express, GraphQL, or similar) - Bonus: past experience as a founder, co-founder, or founding engineer - Ability to work 5 days a week in our San Francisco office with a fully in-person team Compensation The estimated salary range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000. Total compensation for this position may also include stock options. Note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors.

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:97.title: Machinist
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:97.description: The Machinist I is an experienced, self-sufficient craftsperson capable of independently setting up and running CNC and manual equipment with minimal supervision. This role takes ownership of complex jobs from print to finished part, holds tight tolerances, and serves as a technical resource for less experienced machinists on the floor. The ideal candidate is a skilled, self-directed tradesperson who works well in a small, fast-paced precision manufacturing team. This position reports to the Shop Foreman. Key Responsibilities Machining & Setup Set up and operate CNC mills, CNC lathes, and water jet equipment independently. Plan job sequencing and select tooling and fixturing for efficient, quality production. Complete setups from scratch without pre-built setups. Blueprint & Specification Read and interpret complex technical drawings, GD&T callouts, and tight tolerances. Write or edit basic CNC programs and make offsets to maintain required tolerances. Quality & Coordination Perform in-process and final inspections using precision measuring instruments, including micrometers, calipers, CMMs, and other inspection equipment. Identify and communicate quality issues, tooling wear, and equipment concerns to the Shop Foreman. Assist the Shop Foreman with scheduling input and job status updates. Mentor and assist less experienced machinists with setup and machining techniques. Shop Operations & Safety Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work area. Follow established safety procedures and proper PPE requirements. Schedule: Monday–Thursday, 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; Friday, 7:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m. Occasional overtime required Qualifications Required 5+ years of hands-on machining experience in a job-shop or precision manufacturing environment. Proficiency with CNC mills, CNC lathes, and manual machines. Ability to independently set up machines from scratch. Strong blueprint reading skills, including GD&T. Experience with precision measurement and inspection methods. Ability to work independently and manage time effectively to meet deadlines. Team-oriented with a willingness to share knowledge and assist others. Preferred CAM software experience, such as Mastercam, Fusion 360, or similar. Experience with heat treating tool steel. Work Environment & Physical Demands This position is based on the production floor of a machine shop. The employee is regularly exposed to moderate-to-loud noise, machine oil, coolant, metal chips, and dust. Appropriate PPE is provided and required. The role requires standing for extended periods, bending, reaching, manual dexterity, and lifting or moving materials up to 50 lbs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ec4f49b4-7479-.title: Finance Lead
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ec4f49b4-7479-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Finance Lead based in Ireland. This is a high-ownership finance leadership opportunity within a lean, fast-moving technology environment. You’ll take responsibility for the day-to-day finance function while serving as a trusted strategic partner to senior leadership. The role combines FP&A, financial modeling, cash management, reporting, treasury, and operational finance. You’ll help leadership make informed decisions by providing accurate forecasts, actionable insights, and strong financial discipline. Working with a small internal team and external accounting, tax, and audit providers, you’ll have significant autonomy to shape how finance operates. The role is ideal for someone who thrives with responsibility, limited structure, and the opportunity to build efficient financial processes that support sustainable growth. Own the annual budgeting process, maintain operating forecasts and runway models, and provide financial analysis to support business planning and capital allocation. Develop business metrics, financial models, and performance reporting that give leadership clear and actionable visibility into company performance. Manage cash forecasting, liquidity planning, banking relationships, operational controls, and treasury-related activities. Monitor short- and long-term capital requirements and help ensure the organization maintains appropriate liquidity. Coordinate monthly and annual financial reporting, including board, investor, and management reporting packages. Oversee accounting close processes through external providers and ensure financial information is accurate and delivered on time. Manage relationships with external accounting, tax, audit, and other financial service providers, ensuring compliance obligations are completed efficiently. Oversee accounts payable and accounts receivable activities through the internal finance team. Maintain finance policies, procedures, and internal controls appropriate to the organization's size and stage. Support leadership with strategic and special projects, providing financial analysis and recommendations as required. Operate as a proactive finance partner to leadership, balancing financial discipline with the flexibility required in a high-growth environment. Build a finance function that operates efficiently, cost-effectively, and with minimal day-to-day oversight. Requirements 5+ years of relevant finance experience, with strong experience in FP&A, financial planning, and financial modeling. Proven experience working in startups, growth-stage companies, or venture-backed environments where ownership and adaptability are essential. Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, cash management, liquidity planning, and financial performance analysis. Experience managing external accounting, tax, audit, and other financial service providers. Ability to operate independently in a lean organization with limited structure and significant responsibility. Strong analytical and financial modeling capabilities, with the ability to turn complex financial information into practical business recommendations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence partnering with senior leadership and external stakeholders. High ownership mentality, strong attention to detail, and a bias toward action and problem-solving. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution across day-to-day finance operations. Experience with treasury management is a plus. Experience in crypto, digital assets, or blockchain is a plus. Experience with legal entity restructuring, board reporting, investor reporting, or international organizations is advantageous. Benefits Highly competitive base salary of $185,000–$220,000 USD . Flexible and remote work environment. 25 days of annual holiday plus bank holidays . Opportunity to work at the cutting edge

ryzlabs-ryzlabs:lever:a6f50e56-ba0c-4f47.title: Technical Lead
ryzlabs-ryzlabs:lever:a6f50e56-ba0c-4f47.description: About the Role We’re looking for an experienced Technical Lead to join our client's team and lead the technical delivery of complex technology projects for enterprise clients. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for someone who can operate at both the technical and strategic level—driving architecture and engineering decisions while working closely with clients, stakeholders, and multidisciplinary teams. The ideal candidate comes from a technology consulting or professional services environment and has experience leading complex technology initiatives from discovery and solution design through implementation and delivery. Key Responsibilities • Lead the technical direction and delivery of complex client engagements. • Define and oversee software architecture, system design, integrations, APIs, and technical solutions. • Translate business and client requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions. • Lead and mentor engineering teams, establishing technical standards and best practices. • Serve as a technical advisor to clients, communicating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. • Evaluate technologies, architectures, and implementation approaches and make recommendations based on business and technical requirements. • Drive initiatives across the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through implementation and production. • Identify technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs and develop strategies to address them. • Establish best practices around CI/CD, testing, security, observability, and engineering quality. • Collaborate with product, engineering, data, cloud, and business teams to ensure successful project delivery. • Support multiple workstreams and projects while maintaining a strong focus on quality and client outcomes. What We’re Looking For • 10+ years of experience in technology/software engineering, with significant experience in technical leadership. • Previous experience in technology consulting, professional services, systems integration, or enterprise technology environments. • Experience at organizations such as EY, Deloitte, PwC, KPMG, Accenture, IBM Consulting, or similar firms is highly valued. • Proven experience as a Technical Lead, Lead Engineer, Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Engineering Lead, or similar role. • Strong understanding of software architecture, system integration, APIs, cloud technologies, databases, and distributed systems. • Experience leading complex enterprise technology projects from architecture through implementation. • Strong ability to work directly with clients and senior stakeholders. • Experience leading, mentoring, and providing technical direction to engineering teams. • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance technical excellence with business priorities. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. • Advanced English. What Makes This Role Different This role is ideal for someone who wants to go beyond simply writing code and take ownership of technical strategy, architecture, delivery, and client impact. You’ll have the opportunity to work on complex technology initiatives, influence architectural decisions, mentor technical teams, and act as a trusted technical partner to clients. Contractor \u007C Fully Remote \u007C USD Compensation
